expectations.text: Treats 30 March as a decision date and requires a go/no-go call held before it, not after.
expectations.evidence: "Decision date: Sunday 29 March, the last day before the step-up."

expectations.text: States that cancelling now at 60% can beat waiting and cancelling at 85%, and names the difference as a 25-percentage-point step on the contract.
expectations.evidence: "Fee goes 60% → 85%, +25 points of the contract's fee base"; NO-GO: "Cancel or postpone while the fee is still 60%."

expectations.text: Says waiting for more certainty is a real cost priced in percentage points of the contract rather than a free option.
expectations.evidence: "The 25-point step is the price of waiting."

expectations.text: Names registration or ticket pace below break-even inside the last affordable fee window as a condition that should move the decision toward no-go.
expectations.evidence: "Below about 225, or a trailing 14-day pace that projects under 480 | NO-GO".

expectations.text: Requires the go/no-go thresholds, including the ticket number that means go, to be written and agreed before Thursday's meeting rather than decided inside it.
expectations.evidence: "Agree these on Thursday, while nobody has yet lost money on the outcome."

expectations.text: Explains that pre-agreed thresholds exist so that sunk cost and emotional outcomes cannot move the goalposts once everyone is in the room.
expectations.evidence: "Because the thresholds were agreed beforehand, the meeting only reads the numbers."; agree "while nobody has yet lost money".

expectations.text: Uses the polled format in which each area owner votes go or no-go and a single no-go halts, given the co-founders are split.
expectations.evidence: "each owner... votes GO or NO-GO against the thresholds. One no-go halts the sequence."

expectations.text: Names areas to poll beyond ticket pace, including contractual exposure, payment integrity (whether the team can actually collect and refund), and speaker and sponsor confirmation status.
expectations.evidence: Polls ticketing, sponsors, program, venue and finance. Register row 8: "Confirm you can refund every ticket sold".

expectations.text: Does not treat doubling ad spend as the answer on its own, and prices that option against the 19 days remaining before the step-up.
expectations.evidence: "Doubling the budget isn't the same as pushing through." It runs a "ring-fenced 14-day test" with tranches and a pass line.

expectations.text: Notes that poor ticket sales or lack of interest is a standard exclusion in event cancellation cover, so insurance does not rescue this scenario.
expectations.evidence: It says "I'd not count on insurance" and that the shortfall may be a known circumstance. It never says poor ticket sales is a standard exclusion.

expectations.text: Re-scores the demand-shortfall row at today's distance from the event rather than carrying its original score.
expectations.evidence: Row 1: L5 × I4 = 20 Red, "Row 1's likelihood is high only because the gap is real today".

expectations.text: Names organizer discretion - the organizing group deciding not to run the edition with no external trigger - as a legitimate, documented outcome of this call rather than a failure.
expectations.evidence: Row 15 treats the co-founder split as a Red risk to manage with thresholds. It never frames deciding not to run as a legitimate documented outcome.
